chapter: Life Processes in Living Organisms Part 1
stem: A molecule of glucose is completely oxidised in aerobic respiration and molecules of \(H_2O\) and ____ are produced along with energy.
solution: In aerobic respiration one molecule of glucose is completely oxidised in the presence of oxygen to give carbon dioxide and water along with energy (ATP): \(C_6H_{12}O_6 + 6O_2 \rightarrow 6CO_2 + 6H_2O + \text{energy}\). Hence, along with water, \(CO_2\) is produced. Oxygen is used up (not produced), so the answer is \(CO_2\).

Vinegar is a dilute solution of acetic acid. It is produced by acetic acid bacteria (Acetobacter aceti), which oxidise the ethanol of a fermented liquid into acetic acid. Lactic acid is formed by Lactobacillus in curd, so the correct answer is acetic acid.

stem: Any nucleotide of the gene suddenly changes its position that causes a minor change which is nothing but the ____.
solution: A sudden change in the sequence or position of a nucleotide of a gene (DNA) is called a mutation. Mutations bring about heritable variations. Translocation is a specific type of chromosomal aberration, but the general term for such a minor change in a nucleotide is mutation.

chapter: Life Processes in Living Organisms Part 2
stem: In humans, sperm production occurs in the ____ organ.
solution: Sperms (male gametes) are produced in the testes, in the seminiferous tubules, by the process of spermatogenesis (meiosis). The vas deferens and ejaculatory duct only carry the sperms; they do not produce them. Hence the answer is testes.

stem: Solar photovoltaic cell converts the solar radiation energy directly into ____ energy.
solution: A solar photovoltaic (PV) cell is made of semiconductor material that directly converts the energy of solar radiation (sunlight) into electrical energy by the photovoltaic effect. Hence the answer is electrical energy.

chapter: Life Processes in Living Organisms Part 2
stem: Find the odd one out: Fragmentation, Regeneration, Budding, Fertilization.
solution: Fertilization is the odd one out. Fragmentation, regeneration and budding are all methods of asexual reproduction (a single parent, no gamete fusion), whereas fertilization is the fusion of male and female gametes and is a part of sexual reproduction.

stem: Write the correct co-relation: Diabetes : Insulin :: Cancer : ____
solution: Cancer : Interferon. Just as diabetes is treated using the hormone insulin (produced by biotechnology / genetic engineering), cancer is treated using interferon, an anti-cancer/anti-viral protein produced by recombinant DNA technology.

stem: State whether true or false: Study of fossils is an important aspect of the study of evolution.
solution: True. Fossils are the preserved remains or impressions of organisms that lived in the past. Their study (palaeontology) gives direct evidence of evolution — the age, form and gradual changes of extinct organisms — and hence is an important aspect of the study of evolution.

stem: Give any two commercial uses of Biotechnology.
solution: Two commercial uses of biotechnology: (1) Production of medicines and biomolecules such as insulin, interferon, vaccines, antibiotics and hormones by recombinant DNA technology. (2) Production of genetically modified (GM) crops with higher yield and resistance to pests/diseases, e.g. Bt cotton. (Other uses: production of enzymes, biofertilizers and improved products in the food and dairy industry.)

stem: Being a fish, I perform respiration with the help of lungs. Who am I?
solution: I am a lungfish (e.g. Protopterus / Neoceratodus). Although it is a fish (class Pisces), the lungfish can breathe air using lung-like structures in addition to gills; it is regarded as a connecting link between fishes and amphibians.
